authoring: Procedural 3D geometry (foliage at runtime, mineral outcrops by the Blender script) and shaders authored for the Godot presentation; no original sprite RGB or extracted terrain meshes.
design: Per-kind outcrops (grey limestone, strata crag, rust/verdigris copper gossan, galena-studded silver host, gold orichalcum crystals on basalt, sawn white/black marble ledges) on the green ground (only marble quarries keep a sawn floor), continuous mineral beds and low quarry perimeter fragments with walkable centers, sparse olive/sage understory; no shoreline rock scatter.
native_boundary: Read-only tile flags/heights; no collision, navigation, resource quantity, construction rule or RNG changes.
coverage: Actual designated city includes stone/copper/marble/orichalcum. Other resource kinds need native campaign visual coverage. Content review and production release gates still apply.
